vector_memory.semantic_summary: HFPipelineMixin serves as a crucial service layer for integrating Hugging Face (HF) LLMs into the application. Its primary functions involve normalizing conversational history by ensuring roles alternate correctly using _ensure_alternating_roles. It then prepares the final, tokenizable input tensors via _prepare_input, intelligently falling back to manual string formatting if the tokenizer lacks the apply_chat_template method. It bridges application message structures to HF-specific input requirements.
